description: Diff policy rules (Tier 0, Owner file), read by packages/policy evaluateDiffPolicy. Every rule blocks. A missing or invalid file is a deny. Regexes are JavaScript syntax. Globs: ** across segments, * within one, {a,b} alternatives; path matching ignores case.

forbidden_path.description: A change touching a Tier 0 path (the caller passes the Tier 0 list plus the work order's forbidden paths). Renames count on both sides.

outside_allowed_files.description: A change outside the work order's scope.touches globs. An empty list allows nothing.

deleted_test.description: A test file deleted or renamed to a non-test path, or a test file that loses more test cases than it gains.

skipped_test.description: An added line that skips, focuses or expects a test to fail, in any file but Markdown.

config_relaxation.description: A gate config file (lint, typecheck, test runner, CI, hooks, budgets, baselines) that is deleted or renamed away, loses a non-blank line (a changed value counts), or gains a line that turns something off. A purely additive tightening passes.

size_over_cap.description: Changed lines (added plus removed, text files) over the row size cap. A row with no known size gets the unknown_size cap. Lockfiles are generated and not counted (a new dependency is its own rule).

new_dependency.description: A dependency name present after the change and absent before it, in any listed manifest, unless the work order allows new dependencies. A changed manifest whose content is not supplied, or does not parse, is a violation.
